proposed.explanation: There is insufficient evidence to make a responsible buy, sell, or hold recommendation for your portfolio as of 18 November 2026. At cutoff prices of 20.40 EGP for EFID and 141.95 EGP for ETEL, your portfolio totals 59,795.00 EGP, consisting of 15,000.00 EGP in cash (25.09%), 1,500 shares of EFID worth 30,600.00 EGP (51.17%), and 100 shares of ETEL worth 14,195.00 EGP (23.74%). Your cash reserve already covers your potential 10% one-year liquidity need (5,979.50 EGP), though having 51.17% in EFID creates concentration risk given your low financial ability to withstand losses. While the available FY2025 financial statements show substantial scale, they are not sufficient for an investment decision. For EFID as of 31 December 2025, consolidated revenue was 20,915,072,432 EGP. EFID also reported consolidated net profit for the year of 2,695,301,670 EGP. EFID's total equity stood at 5,724,525,864 EGP as of 31 December 2025. For ETEL as of 31 December 2025, consolidated operating revenues were 106,672,946,000 EGP. ETEL reported consolidated total equity of 63,687,826,000 EGP as of 31 December 2025. Critical information is missing: share counts are absent for both companies (preventing P/E, P/B, or per-share valuation against current prices), ETEL has no reported net profit or earnings data, neither company has debt or cash flow figures to assess financial risk, dividend data is missing despite your goal of steady growth with some income, and no 2026 interim results are provided despite the 18 November 2026 cutoff being nearly eleven months after FY2025 year-end. Keep your current position unchanged until complete valuation, leverage, dividend, and 2026 interim financial data are obtained, and recognize that equity investments carry risk of capital loss with no guarantee of returns.
